cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your scheduling software serves 40,000 small businesses, and your support team answers 40-60 conversations a day in Zendesk while keeping CSAT above 90%. That is the same shape as my last 3 years at ShopBall: 60+ chats and emails daily, a 95% satisfaction score, and 12 help-center articles that cut repeat questions for the whole team.

I write clearly in English (C1), I already work CET hours, and your Deel setup works for me in Kosovo. My Spanish (A2) is basic but improving.

I can start within 2 weeks and would be happy to do a trial shift so you can see how I work.

Thanks,
Arta Krasniqi
